scope: Final PhiAgent-Bench v0.1 acceptance after real-audit numerator hardening
summary: PhiAgent-Bench v0.1 is ready as a tested rough benchmark branch; incomplete public evidence is shown without ranking, and a real success cannot count unless the corresponding complete simulation gate passed.
evidence: The final smoke report SHA-256 is 8e358ebfa7c161e85bc6b739fb6549b78e01f15e534bb02934ad67a6544dd647; it is schema-complete and reports H2RCore 94.625 from the structured three-judge fixture.

The final public-preview report SHA-256 is 7f73baef80394a9d5add4872599c8168034de8b389ee88521eef71c33d1a2672; it reports incomplete evidence, H2RCore null, L4 0.0, and E2E-VSR 0.0 while retaining measured IK success 1.0.
Twenty-six focused benchmark, evidence-ledger, recorded-real-evidence, evaluation-statistics, and simulator-interface tests pass; one optional MuJoCo test skips in the dependency-light environment.
The final full CPU regression reports 957 passed, 3 skipped, and the same 2 unrelated main-branch JoyAI failures caused by missing ffmpeg/ffprobe and an existing timeout-argument mismatch.
The RM65/AG2F90-C manifest is compatible with the public case while remaining evidence_only=true and execution_enabled=false; targeted Ruff and git diff checks pass.
lessons: Leaderboard eligibility must depend on evidence completeness, while low-scoring but complete attempts stay visible and rankable.
Valid real-success and goodput numerators must be conditioned on the same case passing the complete L4 gate, otherwise malformed evidence can produce impossible precision above one.
Public kinematic replay is useful benchmark evidence, but its FK residual remains self-consistency rather than source action truth.
limitations: Official H2R evaluator code and case annotations remain unpublished at the pinned revision.
No Isaac Lab 5.1 RoboWM task was executed in this local environment and no model-derived M5 run was performed.
No new blind-reviewed real hardware trial exists; consequently this release is a benchmark infrastructure preview, not a populated production leaderboard.
next_actions: Populate a frozen multi-family suite with redistributable sources and hidden annotations.
Execute RoboWM and full PhiAgent physical gates on a compatible GPU simulator host.
Enable a reviewed hardware adapter only after telemetry, safety, repeated trials, and blind outcome review are operational.
